projecthero.guide.thor.perk.melee: Melee hits land in the Cosmic range whatever you hold: fists 24 (the fastest swing), Mjolnir 24, Stormbreaker 26 (slow), both weapons 27
projecthero.guide.thor.perk.hammer_damag: Mjolnir hits for 22 thrown, Stormbreaker for 24 (each pierce)
projecthero.guide.thor.flight.body: Double-tap Jump while holding Mjolnir or Stormbreaker to fly. Mjolnir flies fastest, both weapons a little slower, Stormbreaker slowest. With empty hands you cannot fly -- use Storm Sprint and Thunder Leap instead. Touch the ground to land.
projecthero.guide.thor.stormbreaker.bifr: Shift+X (Bifrost Travel, with Stormbreaker alone in hand): open the Bifrost menu. Type X, Y and Z (it starts on where you stand) and press Open Bifrost, or use one of three waypoints: name a slot and press Save here to store where you are standing, Go to travel there, and the cross to clear it. Waypoints are yours for good -- they survive relogging, dying and losing the axe. The rainbow bridge carries you and every squadmate within 8 blocks of you (a squadmate can sneak to stay behind); each lands safely -- on solid ground with room to stand, never in a wall, lava or the void. No distance limit inside the world border, but same dimension only. 1-minute cooldown of its own. With Mjolnir in your other hand the Bifrost will not open.
projecthero.guide.thor.combo.finisher: The slam is the finisher: +50% damage on the target (never past 28). With Mjolnir it cracks like thunder, a 22-damage shockwave on everything within 3 blocks of the target. With Stormbreaker it cleaves through everything within 4.5 blocks in front of you for 22. Neither touches you, your pets or your squad. Then the combo starts over.
projecthero.guide.thor.dual.twin_thunder: Twin Thunder Strike: land the 4th hit in time (or press Z) and you raise both weapons to the sky -- lightning strikes both of them and arcs between them -- then slam them together into the ground. 30 damage to every enemy within 6 blocks, thrown up into the air, the ground cracking open, then a ring of lightning bolts around you (22 each). It never hurts you, your squad or anyone's pets. 15-second cooldown; only while you hold both weapons.
projecthero.guide.thor.storm.body: The god of thunder draws on the storm. While it is thundering where you stand -- anywhere it rains or snows, under a roof or not -- or while your own Storm Call (V) rages round you, everything you hit hits 30% harder. No single hit ever goes past 60. Lightning crackles over you while it lasts, and "Storm-Charged +30%" shows above your ability keys.
projecthero.guide.thor.states.intro: What is in your hands decides your moves: nothing, Mjolnir, Stormbreaker, or both. The same key does something different in each state, and the HUD shows the state and the moves its keys hold. Damage is Cosmic tier: melee 21-28, abilities 22-30, ultimates 45-60 per hit.
projecthero.guide.thor.shared.r: R calls your weapon (a right-click throws it). V is Storm Call; Shift+V is God of Thunder; Shift+Z is your state's ultimate (one shared 2-minute cooldown, 90 seconds unarmed). H summons Thor's Armour; N opens the weapon selector.
projecthero.guide.thor.state.unarmed.bod: Empty hands. Blue-white lightning crackles over your fists. Every cooldown is 25% shorter and your punches are the fastest swing (24), but your reach is short and you cannot fly.
projecthero.guide.thor.state.mjolnir.bod: Classic white-blue lightning. The fastest flight; your lightning stuns briefly and Storm Call lasts half as long again. Single-target damage is the lowest of the weapons.
projecthero.guide.thor.state.stormbreake: Lightning and the Bifrost's rainbow. Heavy 26 swings, slow swings and slow flight. Your abilities cut straight through armour and hit 25% harder on an enemy below 30% health, and Shift+X opens the Bifrost.
projecthero.guide.thor.state.twin.body: Mjolnir in one hand, Stormbreaker in the other: lightning and rainbow intertwined. The highest damage and medium flight, but every move costs double Storm Energy and the Bifrost will not open.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.call_weapon: Calls Mjolnir or a bound Stormbreaker to your hand from anywhere; a right-click throws the weapon in your hand.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.thunder_fist: Hold to charge a lightning punch (1.5 s), release to lunge onto the enemy in front: 24 tapped up to 30 fully charged, with a big knockback. 6-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.lightning_pa: A short bolt from your open hand onto the enemy you aim at, up to 12 blocks: 22. 3-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.asgardian_gr: Seize the enemy in front of you, lift it overhead crackling, then hurl it: 24. Bosses are struck but not lifted. 9-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.storm_rush: A four-punch electric flurry stepping forward -- jab, cross, hook, uppercut -- 22 a blow to everything in front. 7.5-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.static_burst: The charge bursts out of your body in a shell of sparks: 22 to everything within 5 blocks, knocked back. 7-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.ground_pound: Both fists raised and driven into the ground: a shockwave of 26 within 5 blocks that throws enemies up. 7.5-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.storm_sprint: Run as lightning for 4 seconds: much faster, sparks streaming off you. 6-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.thunder_leap: A huge leap that comes down in a slam: 28 within 5 blocks, a bolt landing with you. No fall damage. 9-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.lightning_in: Ultimate. For 10 seconds you become living lightning: faster, hard to shove, shocking every enemy near you each second (22). Then you explode: 60 to everything within 10 blocks.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.whirlwind_th: Spin Mjolnir round by its strap, faster and faster, then hurl it: it tears through up to 6 enemies, 24 each, and flies home. 10-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.lightning_st: A bolt from the sky onto what you aim at (soft aim assist): 26, then it arcs on to two nearby hostile mobs for 22. 3.5-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.thunder_fiel: Hurl Mjolnir into the ground ahead: for 4 seconds a 5-block field of lightning shocks every hostile mob in it for 22 each second and slows it. 15-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.storm_dash: Burst forward as a streak of lightning (along your aim while flying), shocking everything you pass for 22. 5-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.meteor_dive: Launch skyward (or dive straight from the air) and come down like a falling star: 28 within 5.5 blocks. 12-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.thunderclap: A two-handed overhead slam: a 7-block shockwave of 26 that knocks back and slows. 6-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.wrath_of_the: Ultimate. You rise with Mjolnir raised; for 2.5 seconds bolts rain on every enemy near you (45 each), then one colossal bolt crashes onto the spot you aim at: 60 within 7 blocks.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.chain_lightn: A crackling cone in front of you, arcing from target to target: 24 each. 8-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.lightning_be: Hold: a thick beam of lightning from the hammer, 22 every quarter second. Drains Storm Energy while held.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.bifrost_hurl: Hurl Stormbreaker on a rainbow wake: it pierces up to 4 enemies for 28 and Sunders each one -- they take 20% more damage from everything for 8 seconds. 10-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.storm_cleave: Raise the axe, let the lightning find it, and chop down on one enemy: 30. 6-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.bifrost_step: Blink up to 20 blocks along a rainbow beam (next to the enemy you aim at) and land in a cleave: 26 in front of you. 10-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.rending_arc: One huge flat sweep through everything in front of you within 6.5 blocks: 24, through armour. 8-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.bifrost_beam: Hold: a narrow, spiralling rainbow beam, 26 every quarter second. Drains Storm Energy faster than the Lightning Beam.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.executioners: Leap with the axe raised and drive it into the ground: 28 within 4.5 blocks, x1.5 on an enemy under 30% health (never over 30). 10-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.bifrost_dash: A rainbow-streak blink 10 blocks ahead (along your aim while flying). 4-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.bifrost_trav: Opens the Bifrost menu (see Stormbreaker below).
projecthero.guide.thor.move.bifrost_judg: Ultimate. Stormbreaker is hurled and impales the enemy you aim at (60), pinning it while the Bifrost gathers above, then the rainbow bridge crashes down on it: 45 within 7 blocks.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.twin_throw: Throw both weapons: they swing out wide, cross, and meet at the target in a blast of thunder and rainbow -- 28 within 4 blocks. 12-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.thunderstruc: Cross the weapons while lightning flows from Mjolnir into Stormbreaker, then slash: a crescent wave runs 13 blocks forward, 28 to everything it passes. 9-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.storm_anchor: Hurl both weapons into the ground: a Thunder Field twice as big (10 blocks). 20-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.crossfire: A bolt from Mjolnir and a Bifrost beam from Stormbreaker converge on the enemy you aim at: 24 + 24. 9-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.twin_beam: Hold: a rainbow beam wound with lightning from both weapons, 28 every quarter second. Drains Storm Energy fast.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.twin_thunder: The Twin Thunder Strike on demand (see below): 30 within 6 blocks, then a ring of bolts. 15-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.ragnarok: Ultimate. You rise between the two weapons while bolts rain round the spot you aimed at (45 each), then hurl Stormbreaker down onto its centre: 60 within 8 blocks in a burst of lightning and rainbow.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.storm_call: Call a thunderstorm round you for 18 seconds (27 with Mjolnir): you are Storm-Charged (+30%) and a 22-damage bolt drops on a nearby enemy every 2.5 seconds. 1-minute cooldown.
projecthero.guide.thor.move.god_of_thund: 15 seconds with your eyes blazing: every hit arcs a 22-damage bolt on to a nearby enemy, and you are much harder to knock back. 45-second cooldown.
